question: By whose grace has the determination of the Kaula teaching been understood?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of Kaulas.
Understanding has occurred by that lord's grace.
What is known is the determination of Kaula.
inference: The speaker claims to have understood the Kaula determination through the grace of the lord of Kaulas.
plain_english: O lord of the Kaulas, by your grace I have understood the determination of the Kaula teaching.
